Cultiway.Construction.BodyHint: This spell exerts force through the actual body. Edit its poses in Body and exertion.
Cultiway.Construction.CopyHint: Teach the chosen learner a separate copy, preserving existing spells and necessary cooldown.
Cultiway.Construction.ReplaceHint: Replace only this learner’s version. Other holders and active casts retain the original.

Cultiway.Construction.Applied: The new revision has been saved and learned.
Cultiway.Construction.FollowMatterHintTe: Changing matter or a conversion enables this. Turn it off to restore fixed surface and damage settings. Dye only changes color.
Cultiway.Construction.DamageFollowsMatte: The current matter sets the main damage type. You can change this under Matter and state.
Cultiway.Construction.AddPathHint: Create an editable flight path from the source or actual attachment. Attached parts detach at launch.
Cultiway.Construction.LocalHint: X, Y and Z follow the part’s local axes at launch, in map tiles.
Cultiway.Construction.TargetLineHint: X is progress from launch to the captured target (0 to 1); Y is sideways tiles and Z is height offset.
Cultiway.Construction.AddPointHint: Append a point 0.25 seconds after the endpoint, then edit its position and handles.
Cultiway.Construction.TooLate: Less than 0.001 seconds remain after launch. Adjust the launch time first.
Cultiway.Construction.NumberRequired: Enter a finite number. The previous value has been kept.
Cultiway.Construction.WorldConstructions: New spell / constructions in this world
Cultiway.Construction.LegacyDraft: Create from an existing base spell
Cultiway.Construction.NoBodyHint: This spell has no body action. Unadapted limbs cannot be added as if they existed.
Cultiway.Construction.UnsupportedEffecto: This part needs a matching body binding
Cultiway.Construction.CarryBodyHint: Keep exertion and recovery, launching from a real equipped artifact. Select your controlled artifact when casting. Defaults to 4 spiritual energy.
Cultiway.Construction.CarrierHint: Select a real equipped artifact. The effect follows it until release, then continues independently. Body and effect share contact limits. Ending returns control and keeps the artifact.
Cultiway.Construction.ExtendBodyHint: Attach a form to the real acting part. Contact follows body stages and stops during recovery or interruption. Defaults to 4 spiritual energy; adjust in properties.
Cultiway.Construction.ExtensionHint: Edit matter and size in properties. The extension stays on the real effector, follows body stages and shares contact limits with the body.
Cultiway.Construction.ProjectBodyHint: Keep exertion and recovery, adding a detached form, tracking and contact. Defaults to 4 spiritual energy; adjust in properties.
Cultiway.Construction.ManifestationHint: Edit matter and size in properties, launch in motion. Body and manifestation share their contact group.
Cultiway.Construction.BodyCoordinatesHin: X is forward, Y sideways and Z height, scaled by actual body height. The last value is torso turn.
Cultiway.Construction.RotationHint: X, Y and Z are local effector rotation angles. The last value is torso turn.
Cultiway.Construction.AddPoseHint: Append a pose 0.1 seconds after the last, preserving position and rotation and extending duration as needed.
Cultiway.Construction.SelectionRangeHint: Range only controls target admission. Hits still follow actual forms and poses; review after changing delivery.
Cultiway.Construction.ActualPaymentNeeds: Select a learner to see the actual cost.
Cultiway.Construction.ActualPaymentUnava: The learner has no available resource or insufficient balance.
Cultiway.Construction.ActualRangeAmount: {0:0.##} tiles before accounting for a specific target.
Cultiway.Construction.ActualRangeNeedsLe: Select a learner to account for their body and action.
Cultiway.Construction.ActualRangeNeedsCa: The distance also depends on where the artifact is when casting.
Cultiway.Construction.PlacementRulesHint: Attachment changes placement; release or flight ends following. Effect timing, repeats and material keep their existing rules.
Cultiway.Construction.MakeFollowHint: Remove root release and flight; preserve internal animation, effects and cost.
Cultiway.Construction.MakeOrbitHint: Create a 3-tile orbit with a 4-second period. Select the child to edit radius, or the pivot to edit angular speed.
Cultiway.Construction.ResizeConstruction: Resize generated geometry and contacts; preserve the actual body and per-contact power.
Cultiway.Construction.HasteConstructionH: Scale motion, homing and path speed together; shorten the full timeline of body-only actions.
Cultiway.Construction.DurationConstructi: Stretch the complete timeline with matching poses and paths; keep contact frequency and limits.
Cultiway.Construction.RepeatConstruction: Total copies, lateral spacing, spawn interval. Perform the body action once; multiply total cost by copies.
Cultiway.Construction.IntegerCountRequir: Total copies must be an integer from 1 to 64
Cultiway.Construction.MagnitudeRulesHint: Apply once to this draft; undo is available. Size, speed and duration keep the stated cost. Presence windows gate both visuals and contacts.
Cultiway.Construction.SustainConstructio: Add a hold phase; preserve flight, strike, recovery, contact rules and cost.
Cultiway.Construction.ImpactRulesHint: Effects require real contact. Positive force pushes, negative force pulls. Ground push seconds disable lift. Stagger allows external force; bind stops horizontal motion and actions. Accepted bind is checked before applying force.
Cultiway.Construction.DefaultImpactHint: Hostile, normal damage, no force. Shared by the body and parts without overrides.
Cultiway.Construction.NoActorImpactHint: Decoration and barriers do not apply actor contact effects.
Cultiway.Construction.ActivationRulesHin: This branch starts at time zero after a confirmed event. Waiting parts are invisible and inactive; the cast lifetime remains the limit.
Cultiway.Construction.MotionRulesHint: Changes this subject without a duplicate. Each condition executes once; contact limits and remaining force are preserved.
Cultiway.Construction.AddMotionHint: Change current motion, size, pose or matter after a real event.
Cultiway.Construction.ConditionalFlightH: This segment begins after an actual event. Its time is the earliest branch age that accepts the event.
Cultiway.Construction.MotionPathHint: Use the existing path page to edit this event flight.
Cultiway.Construction.Ground.EndWhenActi: Land and wait until effects can begin
Cultiway.Construction.FracturePartHint: Divide remaining force among enabled parts; keep the original contact group and role
Cultiway.Construction.FractureNoContact: This part lacks a contact shape or the source is decorative
Cultiway.Construction.KeepSourcePosition: Take over at the source part's position
Cultiway.Construction.InheritAbsorbedFor: Release only force absorbed by the shield, outward from contact
Cultiway.Construction.AddFlowHint: Use existing shape and volume; surface and contact move together
Cultiway.Construction.RemoveFlowHint: Keep shape and volume; remove this flow process
Cultiway.Construction.AddRecoveryHint: End this form and recover its unspent share of the original payment
Cultiway.Construction.RecoveryWorldMater: Also recover owned material in this area
Cultiway.Construction.AddResidueHint: Transfer current generated material to the world; it survives this cast
Cultiway.Construction.RemoveResidueHint: Keep the normal ending of this generated form
Cultiway.Construction.ConvertWorldMatter: Also convert world material in this shape
Cultiway.Construction.WorldMatterHintTex: Select generated material in the actual body shape, keeping its original payer. Terrain and buildings are excluded.
Cultiway.Construction.WorldMatterAnyStat: Allow all states of this matter
Cultiway.Construction.WorldMatterOwned: Only material originally paid for by this caster
Cultiway.Construction.ConductionHintText: Each wave checks connected water again and spends this cast’s remaining force. Each actor is affected once per wave. Native zero-thickness seas do not invent water depth.
Cultiway.Construction.Head: Head
Cultiway.Construction.HeadRotationHint: Degrees around body forward, side and vertical axes. The last value remains torso turn.
Cultiway.Construction.BodyImpactHint: Applies at actual body or held item contact; disable to inherit ability rules.
Cultiway.Construction.ForceRoutingHint: Only touching bodies or real support receive force. Shares total at most 1. Failed routes remain with the current body.
Cultiway.Construction.AddForceRouteHint: Split the last branch’s share equally, then adjust each.
Cultiway.Construction.BodyForceResponseH: Active only during an occupied stance’s action window. One capacity is shared by the entire cast. Unsupported feet cannot unload force.
Cultiway.Construction.ConnectionHint: Control starts after contact; occupied bodies keep their actions. A target must provide the selected part.
Cultiway.Construction.BodyResponseHint: Choose an existing pose after the contact window and a transition duration. Actual results trigger recovery and stop the old attack.
Cultiway.Construction.NoRecoveryPose: Append a pose after the contact window first.
Cultiway.Construction.BodyStagesHint: Stages divide contact windows on one motion; they do not repeat its poses. Counts and intervals update the cost.
Cultiway.Construction.SplitBodyStageHint: Split a single window in two, or separate the last repetition. Keep the original poses.
Cultiway.Construction.RemoveBodyStageHin: Removing the final declaration restores one window between the original outer limits.
Cultiway.Construction.StageEarlyRecovery: Contact or block recovery ends later stages. Remove that result rule below to continue.
Cultiway.Construction.StageImpactHint: These rules override only the selected stage. Disable to inherit body and whole-ability impact.
Cultiway.Construction.BodyOccupancyHint: Motion determines required parts. Reserve extra parts to restrict other actions; clearing a reservation never releases parts needed by the motion.
Cultiway.Construction.BodyPart.Head: Head
Cultiway.Construction.Reserve.Head: Reserve head
Cultiway.Construction.PartRotationHint: Three local angles at the actual organ mount or body joint, in degrees. Contact and presentation use the same pose.
Cultiway.Construction.ActualPartHint: Select an actor with actual organs or body joints to choose another part.
Cultiway.Construction.NamedFeetHint: Offsets from each foot’s own natural position: forward, side and height, in body heights. Lift belongs to the same body process.
Cultiway.Construction.UseActualFeetHint: Use the selected actor’s actual feet. Keep matching curves; new feet start at their natural positions. Bone lengths and terrain still constrain motion.
Cultiway.Construction.NativeFeetHint: Forward, side and lift are in body heights. Lift a foot before moving its landing point; start and finish in the natural stance.
Cultiway.Construction.NativeFeetRequired: Enable footing on the Natural feet page first.
Cultiway.Construction.BodyImpactRecoilHi: The arm draws back along the strike after contact. Distance ranges from 0 to 0.25 body heights; duration uses action seconds.
Cultiway.Construction.BodyPoseMarkersHin: Name an existing pose so strikes, holds and recovery can refer to it. Renaming updates those references.
Cultiway.Construction.BodyFootworkHint: Forward and side offsets follow the starting direction, in body heights. Time is in world seconds. Edit lift and landing on the Natural feet or Named feet page.
Cultiway.Construction.InsertFootworkHint: Split the last segment in half while preserving its curve and the action duration, then edit the inserted point.
Cultiway.Construction.PropagationHint: Requires actual ground contact and connected terrain. Edit the body motion, propagation and effects; unreached or disconnected ground has no effect.
Cultiway.Construction.PropagationGroundR: Downward reach to ground (0 requires direct contact)
Cultiway.Construction.PropagationTilt: Rigid fold angle (0 uses a wave; one solid contact shape, up to 2048 cells)
Cultiway.Construction.DistributionChildH: Add an ordinary child structure, then edit its placement source and parameters.
Cultiway.Construction.DistributionRootHi: This subject is the centre. Select a child structure to edit its placement sites.
Cultiway.Construction.DistributionSpaceH: Each cell centre supplies a site. Effects use each structure's actual shape.
Cultiway.Construction.DistributionPathHi: Curve parameters control spacing without advancing time. Open paths include both ends; loops omit the repeated endpoint.
Cultiway.Construction.AddRayHint: Emit a continuous ray from this part. Remove flight, animation and flow processes on this part first.
Cultiway.Construction.RayRulesHint: Visuals and contact share the actual length. Contact stops and barriers clip the ray.
Cultiway.Construction.RemoveFlightHint: Removes this flight with its velocity, acceleration and curve.
Cultiway.Construction.MakePlacedHint: Create the subject directly at the selected anchor; child processes retain their own motion.
Cultiway.Construction.CurveBuilderHint: Generate editable control points from amplitude and period, keeping the subject, material and effects.
Cultiway.Construction.BuildCurveHint: Waves and spirals retain the existing forward movement and homing. An arc reaches the target in the chosen time and replaces the previous velocity and acceleration.
Cultiway.Construction.RemoveCurveHint: Keep the central flight, homing, material and effects.
Cultiway.Construction.FlightGoalHint: Arrival distance controls travel, not damage reach. Detached branches continue after this part ends.
Cultiway.Construction.RemoveFlightGoalHi: Restore the original homing behavior and keep other flight settings.
Cultiway.Construction.FlightDirectionHin: Use the launch direction without turning back at a finite target point. Reflection also redirects this direction.
Cultiway.Construction.PathDistanceHint: Map centre travel in tiles to one second of curve progress. Speed changes keep the wavelength; a stopped centre pauses the curve.
Cultiway.Construction.SteeringHint: Bias the heading relative to the current target. X is lateral and Y is vertical. Arrival still uses the real target position.
Cultiway.Construction.SteeringPathHint: Curve values add to lateral and vertical bias. Advance by time or actual centre travel.
Cultiway.Construction.CurveLayerHint: Offsets add together. All curves share time or actual centre travel, and each curve loops independently.
Cultiway.Construction.FlightApproachHint: Move directly to the chase point and wait there. Speed can change; vector acceleration cannot be combined.
Cultiway.Construction.OffsetPathHint: Map axes and world time move the chase point. The form still flies there; arrival uses the actual target.
Cultiway.Construction.EventHint.GroundRo: Counts distance along connected ground. Cells beyond a break cannot trigger it.
Cultiway.Construction.EventHint.WaterRou: Triggers at the last water surface actually reached by the pulse. Each follow-up starts only once.
Cultiway.Construction.EventHint.SignalDe: Triggers at the recipient’s feet when the signal is received. Refreshing from the same sender does not trigger it again.
Cultiway.Construction.FlightDirectArriva: Keep the turn rate until the actual goal is reachable, then travel the final segment and stop, end, or continue in the arrival direction. Direct continuation uses centre flight without a position curve or acceleration.
Cultiway.Construction.FlightTransferHint: Remain in place between transfers. Contact uses the departing shape and arrival point; the gap does no damage. Remove continuous position curves and acceleration first.
Cultiway.Construction.ResetContacts: Start a new contact group after transfer
Cultiway.Construction.StepsHint: A part can grow, move and change matter together. Other steps can use named outputs or wait for them.
Cultiway.Construction.NativeOperationHin: Acts on the selected part, at a set time or after a real event.
Cultiway.Construction.RemoveOperationHin: Steps referencing this output need a new input before saving.
Cultiway.Construction.NamedStepsHint: Inputs select the real part and outputs to wait for. List order does not set execution order.
Cultiway.Construction.OperationNameInval: Names must be nonempty and unique. A referenced part operation must keep a name.
Cultiway.Construction.StepContextInput: Provided by the real cast, target or payment.
Cultiway.Construction.StepTargetMissingH: Resolve the part input or reference cycle before editing shape parameters.
Cultiway.Construction.StepInputStage.aft: Wait for process or result: stage
Cultiway.Construction.StepInputMode.afte: Wait for process or result: collection

Cultiway.Construction.ActorContactPolicy: Edits apply to shared contact groups and outputs of the same declaration. Disable to restore once per actor. Body stages use the same rules.
Cultiway.Construction.RadialMotionHint: Uses world distance from the actual part centre. Positive speed pushes outward; negative speed pulls inward. It moves grounded actors and can lift unowned objects from the ground.
Cultiway.Construction.RadialChannelLengt: Wind channel length (0: circle; radius is inlet half-width)
Cultiway.Construction.RadialGroundItems: Lift unowned ground items (0 to 8, 0 off)
Cultiway.Construction.ClashRulesHint: Attacks affect actors and clash. Barriers intercept hostile attacks with actual capacity; explicit part effects can still affect actors. Changing role keeps existing effects; resolve conflicts explicitly.
Cultiway.Construction.ClashGroundBlockHi: Blocks movable hostile ground actors. Friendly and flying actors keep existing passage rules. Uses the actual part surface.
Cultiway.Construction.BetweenRulesHint: 0 is the source, 1 the target, and 0.5 the midpoint. Following uses actual inputs. Existing motion still affects the part; use placement conversion to explicitly remove root delivery.
Cultiway.Construction.DestinationContact: Checks contact at the new position without sweeping the gap. Disable this before disabling following. Actual flight and detached parts still use their own paths.
Contact only at new follow position
Cultiway.Construction.SoulPactHint: Select one friendly actor. Only damage actually borne by the caster is removed from that actor’s hit.
Cultiway.Construction.SourceLossHint: End stops this part. Independent parts may continue with paid resources, remaining force and lifetime. Parts still attached to the source or requiring the real body still end.
Cultiway.Construction.ConcurrentRulesHin: 0 is unlimited. A successful paid cast replaces the oldest instance above the limit for this actor, source and spell. Different spells do not replace each other. Old costs are not refunded.
Cultiway.Construction.DeformationRulesHi: Move continuously from the actual pose to the target. Spacing changes control positions in model coordinates. Local offsets and rotations are added to the bind pose. Spacing of 1 with no local changes restores the bind pose. Existing formation progress and material shape holding are preserved.
Cultiway.Construction.InventoryRulesHint: Reserve original materials before casting. Consumption steps use them and ending releases the unused items.
Cultiway.Construction.InventoryRemoveHin: Inputs used by steps must be retained.
Cultiway.Construction.InventoryUseRulesH: Completion follows actual consumption. Later steps can wait for that result.
Cultiway.Construction.WorldMaterialHint: Successful tile changes consume actual generated material. Insufficient volume prevents the action. Remainders can be left or recovered. Zero uses the existing rule.
Cultiway.Construction.ErosionRulesHint: Gradually erodes according to the actual material. Choose the current form or select world material within its real shape and capacity.
Cultiway.Construction.AgingRulesHint: Requires an accepted real hit. Aging follows native lifespan rules. Equipment uses native durability. Inventory aging advances finite item lifetimes and releases expired items.
Cultiway.Construction.CorrespondenceHint: An image relays only permitted effects from actual contact to its original actor. Time starts when this part appears. The part can outlast the link.
Cultiway.Construction.AddMappingHint: Use the selected part and choose the gates before adding the step.
Cultiway.Construction.MappingUnavailable: Select a movable form, a gate that can touch actors, or the root attached to a borrowed artifact. Separate gates are required.
Cultiway.Construction.MappingHint.MapSpa: Move the same created form, preserving its position and facing relative to the gate.
Cultiway.Construction.MappingHint.MapAct: The selected part is the entrance. Actors count only when they land safely.
Cultiway.Construction.MappingHint.MapArt: Move the original artifact borrowed by the root. Its ownership does not change.
Cultiway.Construction.RetimeErosionHint: Only selected active erosion changes pace. Material, spent energy, and waiting steps are preserved.
Cultiway.Construction.ProcessTimeHint: Starts when erosion actually begins. Outside windows the pace is normal; zero pauses this process only.
Cultiway.Construction.RetimeWindowsHint: Starts when this change takes effect. Remove all windows to restore normal speed.
Cultiway.Construction.AddProcessWindowHi: Add a pause in the first available gap
Cultiway.Construction.RemoveProcessWindo: Restore normal speed for this interval
Cultiway.Construction.ApplyRecommendedCo: Recalculate this draft’s cost and cooldown from its current construction
Cultiway.Construction.ReleaseGrabHint: Release only ends the caster’s own grip. Freeing someone from another caster requires contact with enough force.
Cultiway.Construction.RepairNeedsInputHi: Declare an inventory input in the properties tab before enabling equipment repair.
Cultiway.Construction.RepairHint: Repairs the original item in its slot. One material is consumed only when durability increases; unused material is returned.
Cultiway.Construction.SignalHint: Delivery requires actual contact. It leaves a temporary status on the recipient that can be checked or removed.
Cultiway.Construction.RequiredStatusKeep: Enable the health condition or disable the fallback result before clearing the required status.

Cultiway.Construction.WeaponChamberHint: Receives one unowned weapon early in the active phase, holds it, and throws it through the opening. Set when the part appears, becomes active, and disappears first.
